title: Grilled Veal Schnitzel
description: A classic German dish featuring thinly cut veal, breaded and grilled to perfection. Serve with a side of tangy lemon wedges.
instructions: Season the veal cutlets with salt and pepper.
In a shallow dish, mix together flour, eggs, and breadcrumbs.
Dip each veal cutlet in the breading mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Heat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Add the breaded veal cutlets to the grill and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until golden brown and cooked through.
Serve immediately with a squeeze of lemon juice.
